title: Recurrent decay under an old amalgam, replaced with composite

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: The old silver filling on fourteen is leaking, there's recurrent decay under the margins.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: It's mesial occlusal distal. Removing the amalgam on fourteen.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Decay removed, placing an MOD composite on fourteen.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: If that tooth gets sensitive, call us, it was deep.
